register_model: register a custom model class with the MODELS registry using the register_module decorator
build_model_from_cfg: build a model instance from a config dict using MODELS.build with a type key
register_dataset: register a custom dataset class with the DATASETS registry using the register_module decorator
register_optimizer: register a custom optimizer class with the OPTIMIZERS registry using the register_module decorator
register_hook: register a custom hook class with the HOOKS registry using the register_module decorator
